items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: A Song is Born, 1948, Howard Hawks... Benny Goodman plays a leading role, supported by ... Charlie Barnet

ctx.x: Well, hardly. There's nothing lower on the totem pole with a director than a sideline musician.

"Skyliner." Hey, it's a Snader Telescription, it's not Cowan. It's called, "Skyliner," 1951, three minutes. Snader telescription in which the title number was played by Charlie Barnet and His Orchestra. Claude Williams, -Sah piano, Bill Holman, tenor sax, Dave Wells, trombone, and Bob Dawes, baritone sax. And, "A Song is Born," 1948, Howard Hawks.
Oh, yeah. That's still on. You see that all the time.
